requirements.summary: No write workload, pre-shutdown data snapshot, or post-shutdown data verification was ever captured or attempted. Since the cluster was never successfully restarted with Galera at all, there is no evidence of data being lost, but there is also no evidence any application data existed or survived, so this cannot be scored as satisfied or a definite failure on data grounds alone (it is subsumed by the cluster never coming back up).
